headline_notes: Managing Director at KinEtix Impact and a long-running Catalan entrepreneurship and entrepreneurial-finance figure. Co-Founder and Director of Impuls Agritech (an agritech accelerator co-financed by the European Social Fund Plus, run with IRTA and GBSB Global). Founder and Director of the G-Accelerator at GBSB Global Barcelona; formerly Head of Careers and Entrepreneurship Services and Professor of Investments and Entrepreneurial Finance at GBSB Global Business School. Earlier co-founder of Cep i Nansa SL. PDG from IESE Business School; MSc in International Finance from the Universitat de Barcelona. Focus: EU financial instruments that support entrepreneurs delivered through platforms and ecosystem stakeholders (intermediated funding). Sources: linkedin.com/in/xavierarola, kinetiximpact.com, global-business-school.org (Impuls Agritech).
